items.author: Unknown (plain square note, not a sticky, so Lucid shows no author)
items.interpretation: Replace the site's fonts and colours with the attached Lucid brand tokens: cool greys #282C33 / #4C535D / #A9AFB8 / #DFE3E8 / #F2F3F5 plus white, blue #1071E5 as the primary accent, indigo #635DFF and pink #D916A8 as secondary accents, and Graphik / Graphik Wide / Self Modern (italic, never all caps) as the three typefaces. This reverses much of cycle 3's approved Design Loop look (JetBrains Mono, dark default).
items.proposedChange: In site/assets/site.css, map the colour variables (and the dark-theme overrides) to these tokens with blue-60 as the main accent, and set --font / --font-wide plus a new tertiary italic serif to the Graphik / Graphik Wide / Self Modern stacks. Graphik and Self Modern are licensed fonts the site doesn't host, so visitors would see the system-ui and Georgia fallbacks unless font files are supplied. Open question: keep the dark default + toggle and ASCII hero from cycle 3, or go light?
